messages:
acme-sre: Hey team — after this morning's rollout our assistant started dropping the system instructions in long conversations. We used to get strict JSON output all the way through, now after ~9k tokens it switches to plain text. No errors in the client, just wrong format.

jessica: Sorry to hear that. Can you paste a minimal repro (request id + model + model_version + token counts)? Also are you on hosted vs dedicated?

acme-sre: Request ID: req_0a9f3c, model: rw-13b-v3, model_version header: rw-13b-v3+2026-03-15, deployment: hosted-us-west. Conversation total ~9200 tokens (including system). Not using streaming. No 40x/50x errors. Latency ~700ms->900ms during the failing calls. Example payload:```json
{
  "system": "You are an assistant that MUST respond with JSON schema {action,status,data}",
  "messages": [ /* long multi-turn history, ~60 messages */ ],
  "max_tokens": 1024
}
```

sam: That looks like a long prefix + full history. Two quick Qs: did you pin model_version or use rollout=stable? Any model fallback headers in response?

acme-sre: We didn't pin. The response header shows `x-redwood-fallback: rw-13b-v2` on a few requests. We noticed the behavior started right after canary->stable promotion (deploy-bot posted @03:10 UTC).

deploy-bot: Canary promotion completed: rw-13b-v3 promoted to stable at 2026-03-17T03:10:12Z. :rocket:

mike: Thanks — two hypotheses: 1) a change in memory allocation/path for KV cache leading to earlier system prompt eviction (history-clipping), 2) fallback to v2 which has different prompt-handling heuristics. Can you share the raw response tokens (first 200 tokens of the assistant reply) + the server trace id?

acme-sre: Trace ID: trace_7b2f. First 200 tokens of assistant reply (it starts normal for system JSON, then midway outputs free-form explanation). Pasted snippet:```
{"action":"update","status":"ok","data":{...}}
Then: "Also, just so you know, the user's latest request suggests..."
```

jessica: That exact mid-reply free-form text is consistent with system prompt being evicted from active context. Can you repro with model pinned to rw-13b-v2 (pre-rollout) and to rw-13b-v3 with keep_system_prompt=true? Also enable `X-Redwood-Debug: full` header and send us the resulting logs.

acme-sre: Will try pinning. Quick question: would enabling streaming change token accounting and avoid eviction?

mike: Streaming changes backend buffering but shouldn't change total token window. However batching/merging optimizations during the rollout could alter per-request effective sequence length. For immediate workaround: 1) pin to v2, 2) shorten client-sent history by summarizing older turns, 3) set `system_pin:true` (we rolled out a config flag but it might not be on by default for hosted). We'll validate the rollout change.

acme-sre: Trying pin -> will report back. Thanks.

infra-bot: Note for eng: canary->stable promoted rw-13b-v3 at 03:10 UTC, autoscaler bumped serving pool, kernel A->B selected for 13b on ams-gpu-12.

mike: Filing a quick internal triage, tagging eng-runtime. If reproduce is confirmed we'll roll an emergency config to force system_pin for the affected pool and roll back canary. @jessica can you keep the customer updated?

jessica: On it. I'll follow up when acme-sre confirms repro or pins. :thumbsup:
